    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca

),

    SELECT Claim_Identifier, SUM(Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM loss_amounts
    GROUP BY Claim_Identifier
),
property_losses AS (
    SELECT c.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
           SUM(COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0)) AS incurred_loss
    FROM acme_insurance.main.claim AS c
    LEFT JOIN claim_losses AS cl
      ON c.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_premiums AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier, pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier) AS Insurable_Object_Identifier,
           SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS p
      ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd

)
